Profile Sulfadimidine is a short-acting sulfonamide with properties sim- ilar to those of sulfamethoxazole (p.340). It is well absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract and is about 80 to 90% bound to plasma proteins. Reported half-lives have ranged from 1.5 to 4 hours in fast and 5.5 to 8.8 hours in slow acetylators.
